subject: Engine 1 Live Fire data hygiene: teamCount and memberNames are out of sync
description:
Found by inspect-tournaments.js while verifying taskboard 419 on 2026-09-26. PRE-EXISTING and unrelated to per-team flags; explicitly not introduced by that work and not fixed by it. Three findings on tournament 1mA2hvZTZDC0KJGSzcCD: (1) teamCount says 0 but the teams collection holds 6, so anything rendering that counter is wrong; (2) team-blue members(1) vs memberNames(2) out of sync; (3) team-red members(0) vs memberNames(1) out of sync. memberNames is what the podium and board display, so a roster and its displayed names disagreeing is student-visible. Not touched because it is a separate concern from flag fairness and changing roster state on a live tournament is the operator's call. ALSO, separate and minor: red-cell has TWO live wetty token containers on bc2, 37849d7ab4b6 and the rotated e2790e91b763, both reaching 192.168.122.173. The pool entry uses the rotated one, so access is correct, but the superseded token still works and was never retired.
[2026-09-26 19:42] CORRECTION to this item's red-cell note, measured properly 2026-09-26. I first wrote that the superseded red-cell token 'still works', then tested it on port 7716 and got 404 and nearly recorded the opposite. Both were sloppy. ACCURATE: the stale container engine1-wetty-tok-red-cell is bound to 127.0.0.1:7706 (not 7716, which belongs to the rotated -v2 container), and its token DOES serve 200 there. BUT /etc/cloudflared/config.yml routes only 7701-7705 and 7716, so 7706 is NOT publicly exposed. It is a loopback-only leftover: a live terminal into red-cell for anyone with shell on bc2, not an internet-reachable path. Low severity, worth retiring the container, not urgent.
[2026-09-27 19:03] DATA HALF RESOLVED 2026-09-26/27. teamCount and members/memberNames were repaired on Engine 1 Live Fire (1mA2hvZTZDC0KJGSzcCD), which is now ENDED, and the replacement tournament Engine 1 Live Fire II (FzqDDgDM1bXUg8RhDL7L) reports pre-flight clean. The root cause of the memberNames half is fixed in code (ctfJoinTeam self-heals a lock whose members entry is missing; _resolveUserName no longer falls back to a uid or an email) and deployed. REMAINING, and the only reason this stays open: the superseded red-cell wetty container is still running, bound to 127.0.0.1:7706 with its old token, and that token DOES serve 200 there. cloudflared routes only 7701-7705 and 7716, so it is loopback-only and not reachable from the internet - a leftover for anyone with shell on bc2, not a student-facing hole. Retiring that container closes this item. Corrected twice before being measured properly: I first claimed it worked, then tested the wrong port and nearly recorded the opposite.
